empty.title: No knowledge bases yet
empty.description: The daily knowledge digest is off. Create a knowledge base to turn it on.

fields.name: Name
fields.description_placeholder: Who it serves and what it covers
fields.description_hint: Agents use the description to decide whether to use this knowledge base.

create.title: New knowledge base
create.description: Uses the built-in schema. You can change it in settings.
create.agent_hint: Tell the agent who the knowledge base serves and what it covers. It drafts the name, description and purpose; you confirm to create it.

settings.title: Knowledge base
settings.manage_hint: Only the creator, an owner or an admin can change this.

repo.title: Repository
repo.shared: All knowledge bases of the workspace share one repository, one directory each.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Unzip and open it in Obsidian.

delete.title: Delete knowledge base
delete.hint: Removes the {{slug}}/ directory. It can't be restored from the app.
delete.impact: Commits the removal of {{slug}}/ and closes {{annotations}} open annotations and {{changes}} open change requests.
delete.last: This is the last knowledge base. The daily knowledge digest will be turned off.
delete.type_name: Type the knowledge base name to confirm

pages.empty: No pages in this domain yet
pages.no_pages: No pages yet. Agents write them when you ingest sources.

sources.private: Only its owner can open it

search.label: Search knowledge
search.press_enter: Press Enter to record it as a gap

gaps.hint: Questions search couldn't answer and gaps agents recorded. The daily digest fills them first.

review.needs_admin: An owner or admin merges this
review.close_description: Its annotations go back to pending and the branch is deleted.
review.check_stale_clean: No pages past their review date

history.revert_hint: Reverting opens a new change request that takes effect once merged.
history.revert_conflict: Later changes touch the same lines. Revert by hand.

edit.title: Edit · {{title}}
edit.label: Page markdown
edit.hint: Submitting opens a change request. It takes effect once an owner or admin merges it.

annotations.anchor_lost: The sentence changed and can't be found. Kept as a page annotation.
annotations.body_placeholder: What's wrong and what it should say
annotations.rail_empty: Click a sentence to annotate it.

picker.title: Choose the maintainer agent for {{kb}}
picker.description: Annotation fixes, ingests, freshness checks and merges go to it by default. You can change it in settings.
picker.description_create: It drafts the knowledge base with you in a conversation.
picker.none: This workspace has no agents yet

ingest.title: Ingest into {{kb}}
ingest.description: The agent reads the sources, writes source summaries and updates related pages.
ingest.own_chats_only: Only your own chats are listed.
ingest.files_hint: Attach files directly in the session.

merge.title: Merge knowledge
merge.description: The agent merges the content, rewrites links and opens a change request.
merge.other_kb: Knowledge base of the other page
merge.kb_hint: The source directory is removed. It takes effect once the change request is merged.

titles.create: Create a knowledge base with an agent

session.subtitle: {{agent}} · {{kb}}
session.empty: The agent replies here once it picks up the task.
session.create_prompt: Who is this knowledge base for, and what should it cover?
session.no_changes_yet: Change requests show up here once the agent submits them.
session.draft_pending: The draft shows up here once the agent proposes one.
session.rebase_action: Ask the agent to update on main
session.open_source: Open the session that produced this
session.owner_only: Only the person who started this session can open it

first.fix: Following the AGENTS.md of {{kb}}, handle these {{n}} annotations, self-review and open a change request (pass --annotations):
first.ingest: Following the AGENTS.md of {{kb}}, ingest these sources, self-review and open a change request:
first.fresh: Following the AGENTS.md of {{kb}}, run a freshness check: run marvis kb lint and marvis kb stale and record each real problem with marvis kb annotate add instead of editing pages.
first.merge_pages: Following the AGENTS.md of the knowledge bases involved, merge these duplicate pages: keep one, turn the other into a pointer, update links, self-review and open a change request:
first.merge_kb: Following both AGENTS.md files, merge {{from}} ({{fromSlug}}/) into {{into}} ({{intoSlug}}/): move pages, remove duplicates, update links, then remove {{fromSlug}}/. Self-review and open a change request.
first.gap: Following the AGENTS.md of {{kb}}, fill these knowledge gaps, self-review and open a change request:
first.rebase: Change request #{{number}} (branch {{branch}}) conflicts with main. Run marvis kb sync, redo it on the latest main, then marvis kb change update {{number}}.

digest.title: Daily knowledge digest
digest.hint: Shared by the whole workspace. Each day it reads tasks, comments and the chats of the agent's runtime owner, then opens one change request.
digest.no_knowledge_base: Create a knowledge base to enable it
digest.admin_only: An owner or admin sets this up
digest.failed: Could not update the daily knowledge digest
